name: Engineering data standards (ISO 15926, CFIHOS)
principle: ISO 15926 provides a shared vocabulary for data integration and hand-over between systems, using RDF triple stores. CFIHOS is a set of specifications and a reference data library for information handover on capital projects.

process_steps.name: Map internal data to standard classes and templates
Exchange or hand over triple stores or CFIHOS data

limitations: The page does not relate CFIHOS to ISO 15926

sources.note: IOGP JIP36, CFIHOS home page (read 25 October 2026)
